2: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthan. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
3: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress- I will never be greatly shaken.
4: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
5: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
6: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
7: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
8: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
9: Trust in him at all times, O people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
10: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
11: Do not trust in oppression. Do not become vain in robbery. If riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
12: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
13: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
